description: This Java class 'EnumToString' processes C header files containing enum definitions to generate corresponding C++ functions that convert enum values to strings. It reads enum definitions, extracts enum constants, and generates switch-case code for string conversion, producing C++ header and source files.

classes.name: EnumToString
classes.description: Java class that reads C enum definitions from a header file and generates C++ code to convert enum values to strings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that initializes processing, takes input and output paths, and triggers enum processing and file writing.

methods.name: writeCppAndHeaderFiles
methods.description: Writes the generated C++ source and header content to files.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads the input header file, extracts enum definitions, and generates corresponding C++ code.

methods.name: removeSpaces
methods.description: Removes all whitespace from a line.

methods.name: isKeyValueLine
methods.description: Checks if a line matches the pattern of an enum key-value line.

methods.name: makeCode
methods.description: Generates C++ switch-case code for a given enum name based on extracted enum values.

methods.name: getMethodSignature
methods.description: Constructs the method signature string for enum-to-string function.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Capitalizes the first letter of the enum name.
